name: Acceptance canvas
description: The acceptance run's stand-in for a start-page plugin (the session canvas's lane CP supplies the real one): its `main` entry keyed `start` is MOSS Code's start page, listing each agent with its mark and starting a session through the app's door with a model, an effort and a recent folder; its `session.corner` entry is a control that returns to the start page; and a button opens a bot in MOSS.
